checks.safeSummary: The canonical Render API and Vercel web origins are healthy and expose the same verified full release commit.

Protected staging, clean-database, restored-backup, Render pre-deploy, and isolated failed-migration recovery rehearsals reached the approved ten-migration baseline without exposing connection details or changing production.

Both canonical origins were switched to the previous known-good release, verified at the same SHA, restored to the candidate, and verified at the same candidate SHA without recording protected configuration.
Invite, session, revocation, ownership, identifier-guessing, and two-user isolation controls pass deterministically.

Two fresh hosted users completed isolated fixture and controlled Stack Exchange live journeys, owner-scoped evidence, ranking, and feedback checks, transactional deletion with stale-resource denial, and logout on the verified candidate release.
Owner-scoped graph deletion, rollback, idempotency, stale identifiers, and orphan checks pass deterministically.
The approved frozen benchmark passes clustering, duplication, citation, repeatability, and ranking thresholds.
The official Stack Exchange read-only API path passed the opt-in source-neutral live pipeline smoke test; Reddit remains unverified.
An operator-observed hosted live scan completed the schema and citation validated Gemini stage without fixture substitution.
Fixture mode is explicit and failed live execution does not become a successful fixture-labeled-as-live scan.
The named operator received an official Render deployment failure notification.
A private logical backup restored into isolated PostgreSQL and passed migration, integrity, and API health checks.
The production Supabase PostgreSQL project has operator-observed automated daily backups with seven-day retention, satisfying the approved 24-hour database-backup RPO.
